en.name: Hue Art Gallery
en.home_text:
HUE Art Gallery opened its doors on June 27, 2025, with the mission of introducing and promoting Mongolian painting and contemporary visual art to both local and international audiences. As part of the opening, the gallery successfully organized its very first exhibition, “HUE”, featuring the works of six distinguished Mongolian artists.
Our gallery is dedicated to presenting artists’ works to the public, fostering art education through creative expression, and curating engaging cultural events through art. We also aim to collaborate with international artists, expanding cultural exchange and developing joint projects and programs.
With an exhibition space of 850 square meters, HUE Art Gallery can simultaneously showcase around 100 artworks. In addition, we have an art storage facility that meets international standards, capable of preserving more than 400 works of art for long-term safekeeping. These works are continuously studied, promoted, and shared with the public.
en.footer_text: Celebrating art, one brushstroke at a time.
